Dominant and Recessive Traits: how can two tall pea plants give a short one? Class 10 Biology Heredity.

• Mendel crossed a tall pea plant with a short one: every F1 plant was tall, none medium
• He let the F1 plants self-pollinate: about one quarter of the F2 plants were short
• Each trait has two copies (genes). T for tall is dominant: one copy is enough
• t for short is recessive: only tt plants are short
• Tt self-cross gives TT, Tt, Tt, tt: about 3 tall, 1 short
